proof_body:
by
  intro f a b M hf hM x hx y hy
  have hab : a ≤ b := hx.1.trans hx.2
  have ha : a ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hab
  have hi : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume s t := fun s hs t ht =>
    (hf.mono (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc hs ht)).intervalIntegrable
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hi a ha x hx) (hi a ha y hy)]
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := y) (b := x) (f := f) (C := M) (fun t ht =>
    by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hM t (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc hy hx (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)))
  rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b M : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f t| ≤ M) → ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |(∫ t in a..x, f t) - ∫ t in a..y, f t| ≤ M * |x - y|
